Definition: from G2788 and a derivative of the same as G5603; a lyre-singer(-player), i.e. harpist:--harper.
BiblicalUsage: Kitharoidos is the harper, the lyre-singer. Revelation 14:2 hears the voice of harpers harping with their harps, and Revelation 18:22 says the voice of harpers shall be heard no more at all in fallen Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the harper's voice marks the difference between the two cities: in heaven it sounds forever, and in Babylon it falls silent.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
